.metrics th:first-child, .metrics td:first-child { text-align: left; }
.equations { background: #f7f7f7; border-left: 3px solid #777; font-size: 0.75rem; margin: 0.35rem 0 0.7rem; padding: 0.45rem 0.7rem; }
.equation { display: inline-block; margin: 0.12rem 1.1rem 0.12rem 0; }
.plot-scroll { margin: 0.35rem 0 0.9rem; overflow-x: auto; width: 100%; }
.plot-grid { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; width: 100%; }
.plot-heading, .plot-row-label { align-items: center; display: flex; font-size: 0.68rem; font-weight: 600; justify-content: center; text-align: center; }
.plot-cell img { display: block; height: auto; width: 100%; }
.corruption-grid { display: grid; gap: 0.6rem; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); margin: 0.35rem 0 1rem; }
.corruption-grid figure { margin: 0; }

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import html
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path


HERE = Path.cwd()
report = json.loads((HERE / "report.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
dataset_path = HERE / report.get("dataset_index", "dataset.json")
dataset = json.loads(dataset_path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if dataset_path.exists() else {"samples": []}


def load_json(path):
    try:
        return json.loads(Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    except (OSError, ValueError, TypeError):
        return {}


def sample_records():
    records = {}
    for relative in dataset.get("samples", []):
        manifest_path = (dataset_path.parent / relative).resolve()
        manifest = load_json(manifest_path)
        metadata = manifest.get("metadata") or {}
        qa = load_json(manifest_path.parent / metadata.get("imaging_qa", ""))
        corruptions = metadata.get("corruptions") or []
        corruption = {}
        if corruptions:
            corruption = load_json(
                manifest_path.parent / corruptions[0].get("corruption", "")
            )
        records[manifest.get("sample_id")] = {
            "manifest": manifest,
            "qa": qa,
            "corruption": corruption,
        }
    return records


records = sample_records()


def esc(value):
    return html.escape(str(value))


def show(value):
    if value is None or value == "":
        return "—"
    try:
        number = float(value)
    except (TypeError, ValueError):
        return esc(value)
    return "—" if not math.isfinite(number) else f"{number:.6g}"


def equations(definitions):
    items = []
    for definition in definitions:
        latex = esc(definition.get("latex", ""))
        description = esc(definition.get("description", ""))
        items.append(
            f'<span class="equation" title="{description}">${latex}$</span>'
        )
    return '<div class="equations">' + "".join(items) + "</div>"


def metric_row(source_id, suffix, level):
    record = records.get(f"{source_id}_{suffix}", {})
    qa_metrics = (record.get("qa", {}).get("metrics") or {})
    residual = qa_metrics.get("residual") or {}
    corruption_report = record.get("corruption", {})
    context = corruption_report.get("context") or {}
    solution = corruption_report.get("solution") or {}
    corruption = corruption_report.get("metrics") or {}
    antenna = None
    if solution:
        antenna_id = solution.get("antenna_id")
        antenna_name = context.get("antenna_name")
        antenna = f"{antenna_name} (ID {antenna_id})"
    physical = solution.get("g_amp")
    if physical is None:
        physical = solution.get("phi_deg")
    values = (
        level,
        antenna,
        qa_metrics.get("clean_peak_jy_per_beam"),
        residual.get("scaled_mad_jy_per_beam"),
        residual.get("rms_jy_per_beam"),
        residual.get("peak_over_scaled_mad"),
        residual.get("p99_over_scaled_mad"),
        residual.get("p99_5_over_scaled_mad"),
        qa_metrics.get("dynamic_range_scaled_mad"),
        solution.get("eps_g"),
        corruption.get("eps_vis"),
        corruption.get("SNR_corr"),
        physical,
    )
    return "<tr>" + "".join(f"<td>{show(value)}</td>" for value in values) + "</tr>"


def metrics_table(source_id, family):
    rows = [metric_row(source_id, "not_corrupted", 0)]
    for target in report["configuration"]["SNR_corr_targets"]:
        text = str(int(target)) if float(target).is_integer() else f"{target:g}"
        rows.append(metric_row(source_id, f"{family}_snr_{text}", text))
    physical = "Amplitude gain" if family == "amp" else "Phase offset (deg)"
    headings = (
        "SNR_corr_target", "Antenna", "clean peak (Jy/beam)", "sigma_R (Jy/beam)",
        "rms_R (Jy/beam)", "max=|R|_max/sigma_R",
        "p99=P99(|R|)/sigma_R", "p995=P99.5(|R|)/sigma_R",
        "DR=clean_peak/sigma_R", "eps_g=|g-1|",
        "eps_vis=||Delta_V||_2/||V||_2",
        "SNR_corr=||Delta_V/sigma||_2", physical,
    )
    return (
        '<table class="metrics"><thead><tr>'
        + "".join(f"<th>{esc(item)}</th>" for item in headings)
        + "</tr></thead><tbody>"
        + "".join(rows)
        + "</tbody></table>"
    )


def image_comparison(rows):
    channels = ("dirty", "clean", "residual")
    columns = max(1, len(rows))
    minimum_width = 5 + 10 * columns
    cells = [
        '<div class="plot-scroll">',
        f'<div class="plot-grid" style="grid-template-columns: 5rem repeat({columns}, minmax(10rem, 1fr)); min-width: {minimum_width}rem">',
        '<div></div>',
    ]
    for row in rows:
        cells.append(f'<div class="plot-heading">{esc(row.get("title"))}</div>')
    for channel in channels:
        cells.append(f'<div class="plot-row-label">{esc(channel)}</div>')
        for row in rows:
            path = esc(row.get(channel, ""))
            title = esc(f'{row.get("title", "")} {channel}')
            cells.append(
                f'<a class="plot-cell" href="{path}" target="_blank">'
                f'<img src="{path}" alt="{title}"></a>'
            )
    cells.extend(("</div>", "</div>"))
    return "".join(cells)


def corruption_comparison(rows):
    cells = ['<div class="corruption-grid">']
    for row in rows:
        path = esc(row.get("path", ""))
        target = show(row.get("SNR_corr_target"))
        cells.append(
            f'<figure><a href="{path}" target="_blank"><img src="{path}" '
            f'alt="SNR_corr={target} applied corruption"></a>'
            f'<figcaption>SNR_corr_target={target}</figcaption></figure>'
        )
    cells.append("</div>")
    return "".join(cells)


print(f"<h1>{esc(report.get('title', 'Dataset v1'))}</h1>")
print(f"<p>{esc(report.get('description', ''))}</p>")
iteration = report.get("dataset_iteration") or {}
configuration = report.get("configuration") or {}
print("<h3>Metric definitions</h3>")
print("<p><span class='muted'>R denotes residual-image pixels inside the dashed 3-beam to border-minus-1-beam annulus. V is the noiseless sky visibility, Delta_V=V_corr-V is measured before noise, and every branch receives the same thermal-noise request and seed. SNR_corr is visibility-space; max, p99, p995, and DR describe the image.</span></p>")
print(equations(configuration.get("image_metric_definitions", [])))
print(equations(configuration.get("corruption_metric_definitions", [])))
print('<div class="summary">')
print(f"Partition: <strong>{esc(report.get('partition'))}</strong><br>")
partition_counts = report.get("source_partition_counts") or {}
print(
    "Completed thermal sources by partition: "
    + " · ".join(f"{esc(name)}={show(count)}" for name, count in partition_counts.items())
    + "<br>"
)
print(f"Completed sources: {len(report.get('sources', []))} / {len(report.get('source_ids', []))}<br>")
print(f"Retained dataset samples: {iteration.get('sample_count', len(dataset.get('samples', [])))}<br>")
print(f"Intermediate CASA products retained: {report['configuration'].get('keep_intermediate_products')}<br>")
print(
    "Exported CASA mask pixels: "
    f"<strong>{esc(report['configuration'].get('fits_invalid_policy'))}</strong> with "
    f"{show(report['configuration'].get('fits_fill_value'))} Jy/beam<br>"
)
print(f"Final dataset imaging pblimit: <strong>{show(report['configuration'].get('dataset_pblimit'))}</strong><br>")
print(f"Reusable thermal source run: <span class='muted'>{esc(report.get('source_run'))}</span>")
if report.get("failures"):
    print("<div class='failure'>" + esc(report["failures"]) + "</div>")
if report.get("excluded_sources"):
    excluded = "; ".join(
        f"{item.get('id')} ({item.get('partition')}): {item.get('error')}"
        for item in report["excluded_sources"]
    )
    print("<div class='failure'>Excluded upstream sources: " + esc(excluded) + "</div>")
print("</div>")

for source in report.get("sources", []):
    source_id = source["id"]
    baseline = records.get(f"{source_id}_not_corrupted", {})
    baseline_metrics = (baseline.get("qa", {}).get("metrics") or {})
    simulation_manifest = baseline.get("manifest", {}).get("metadata") or {}
    simulation = {}
    if simulation_manifest:
        manifest_path = HERE / "samples" / f"{source_id}_not_corrupted"
        simulation = load_json(manifest_path / simulation_manifest.get("simulation", ""))
    noise = simulation.get("noise") or {}
    print(f"<h2>{esc(source_id)} <span class='muted'>[{esc(source.get('partition'))}]</span></h2>")
    print('<div class="summary">')
    print(
        "Corruption antenna: independently selected per variant · "
        f"matched source S/N: {show(source.get('source_snr'))} · "
        f"predicted image RMS: {show(source.get('predicted_image_rms_jy_per_beam'))} Jy/beam · "
        f"thermal simplenoise: {show(noise.get('simplenoise_jy'))} Jy · "
        f"baseline clean peak: {show(baseline_metrics.get('clean_peak_jy_per_beam'))} Jy/beam · "
        f"baseline clean DR/MAD: {show(baseline_metrics.get('dynamic_range_scaled_mad'))}"
    )
    print("</div>")
    for family, title, image_key in (
        ("amp", "Amplitude corruption", "amplitude_plots"),
        ("phase", "Phase corruption", "phase_plots"),
    ):
        print(f"<h3>{title}</h3>")
        print(metrics_table(source_id, family))
        print(image_comparison(source.get(image_key, [])))
        print("<h3>Configured, sampled, and applied gain</h3>")
        print(corruption_comparison((source.get("corruption_plots") or {}).get(family, [])))
```
